Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Vlade Divac?

Vlade Divac is 58 years old.

Where was Vlade Divac born?

Vlade Divac was born in Prijepolje, Serbia.

When was Vlade Divac born?

Vlade Divac was born on February 3, 1968.

How tall is Vlade Divac?

Vlade Divac is 7-1 (216 cm) tall.

How much did Vlade Divac weigh when playing?

Vlade Divac weighed 243 lbs (110 kg) when playing.

Is Vlade Divac in the Hall of Fame?

Vlade Divac was inducted to the Hall of Fame as a Player in 2019 (Full List) .

When was Vlade Divac drafted?

Vlade Divac was drafted by Los Angeles Lakers, 1st round (26th pick, 26th overall), 1989 NBA Draft.

What position did Vlade Divac play?

Center.

When did Vlade Divac retire?

Vlade Divac last played in 2005.

What is Vlade Divac's net worth?

Vlade Divac made at least $93,120,635 playing professional basketball.

How much did Vlade Divac make?

Vlade Divac made $12,051,510 in 2004.

What did Vlade Divac average?

Vlade Divac averaged 11.8 points, 8.2 rebounds, and 3.1 assists per game.

How many rings does Vlade Divac have?

Vlade Divac won 0 championships.
